Ga baki d'aya hankalin su ya yi kan Ummulkhairi, jin ta sheqe da dariya ta cakumi wuyan Dr, tana fad'in.
 “Wallahi k'arya kake kayi kad'an ka kashe shi A barka, nima kasheka zanyi,yaya Abdoul tashi ka gani zan rama maka, shima kashe shi zanyi.”
Ta k'arashe maganar tana wata irin dariya.
 Shattima ganin halin da Ummulkhairi ta shiga, ba qaramin tayar masa da hankali yayi ba.
Cikin wani irin sauri shi da Mamy suka  iso wajansu, bakin Shattima na maimaita kalmar.

Ammi da Mamy kuka kawai suke basu iya sake cewa uffan ba.
Shattima dak'yar ya samu suka fita da Khairy aka kaita b'angaran masu matsalar k'wak'waluwa, aka shiga bincikar lafiyarta.
Gawar Abdoul kuwa an kaita wajan ajiye gawawaki.
Khairy anci uban fama da ita kafin asamu ayi mata bincike, tare da banka mata alluran bacci na tsawon 24 hours, domin k'wak'waluwarta ta samu ta huta, dan da gaske ta samu gushewar k'wak'waluwa, abubuwan ba qaramin razanata sukayi ba,bata san me take ba ayanzu.

Abba Aminu yace.
“A'a Sam hakan bazai yuba waye baisan laruraba, ku zauna don Allah akwana biyu har ta dawo hayyacinta, sai kutafi ni kaina badan dole ba inda zamuje sai Kharynmu ta samu sauqi.”
Shattima kallon Aminu kawai yake baice komai ba, shi kam baisan irin abokin da Allah ya had'ashi da shi ba nagartaccen mutum...
Washegari kuwa Shattima Bilkisu ya bari wajan Khairy ya biyo su Aminu Nigeria dan Sam bazai iya zama ba acan ayi jana'izar Abdoul babu shi ya gwammaci kome zai faru da Khairy ya faru akan dai ya zauna a Singapore wajanta yabaro amininsa.

*Gumel*

Bayan kwana uku Shattima ya fara shirin tafiya Singapore shida yayunsa  Munnir da auntie Aisha sai Adamu yayan Bilkisu, dan yace dole itama k'anwarsa tana buqatar ganin nata akusanta.

Acan kuwa Singapore Khairy tin bayan da allura ta saketa, hauka tuburan take cizo yak'ushi ga wata irin dariya da takeyi,abun sai muce Allah bata lafiya,alluran bacci da wanda zasu sanya k'wak'waluwarta ta dawo daidai sannu sannu aketa maka mata  sune hutunta.

Mamy cike da mamaki take kallon Khairy idanunta abud'e tana kallon silin d'akin hawaye da majina jargab akan fuskarta, alamun sun nuna yau ta farka acikin hayyacinta.

Shin meye asalin labarinsu??

Abdallah (Shattima) Umar fulanine na asali, mahaifinsu Umar malami ne babba mai tsoron Allah.
Su shidda ne wajan mahaifinsu, shine d'a na 3 wajan liman Umar, kuma shi d'ayane wajan mahaifiyarsa randa ta haifesa ranan ta rasu ta barma Inno amanarsa.

Liman Umar Fulanin GARIN MALAM ne, nan ne asalinsu Amman tin zamnin kakansu suke garin jigawa.
Liman tsayayyan namijine agidansa, yanada rufin asiri tin can asali sunada dukiyar dabobi da suka gada wajan iyayansa, su biyune wajan iyayansu shi da Rabi'atu, matansa na aure biyu, Inno ita Ce uwar gida 'yayanta biyar  sai Bahijja, wacce ta kasance mahaifiyar Shattima, bayan aurensu da shekara biyar ta samu cikin Shattima, Tasha wuya kafin cikin ya girma, har yakai ga haihuwa, randa yazo duniya kuwa tace ga garinku nan cikin ciwon mutuwa ta dinga saka masa albarka da yafe masa akan naqudarsa da ta bata wahala, ta barma inno amanarsa ta kuwa riqe.
Dan Shattima bai san wata uwaba bayan inno yadda ta raini 'yayanta haka ta renaisa, ta tarbiyantar da shi.
Munnir shine Babban su sai Aisha shi yake bima Aisha, shi kuma Nuraddin yake bimasa, sai Balaraba da autarsu Bahijja wacce taci sunan mahaifiyar Shattiman, dukkansu sunada aure da yara.
Sun samu ilimi na addini da boko sosai, Shattima tin yana yaro mutum ne mai barkwanci da wasa da dariya, haka baida qin jama'a, kyakkyawane sosai baqin bafulatani, talaulayi bayada jiki Amman akwai kyawun jiki, ga farin jinin al'umma,haka yanada wani irin kwarjini, Allah ya had'ashi da 'yan uban nagari masu k'aunarsa kamar yadda Liman yafi sonsa sai dai bazaka tab'a ganewa ba.
Duka karatunsa har jama'i anan Nigeria yayi sabida shi mutum ne wanda bayada girman Kai ko kad'an duk da kuwa mahaifinsa nada hanyar fitar da shi. Tin yana secondary school Allah ya had'asu aminci da Aminu and Hashim duk da sun girmemasa amma jininsu ya had'u suka zama amini kirki, Aminu d'an kazaure ne, yayin da Hashim d'an Ringim ne.
Koda Shattima ya fara aikinsa bai Fara da qaramin aiki ba da babban muqami ya fara, sabida qwazonsa alokacin ne ya fara fita qasasashen waje tsawon shekaru 4 yayi a Australia, kafin ya dawo yana dawowane Allah ya had'ashi da Bilkisu Bilal wato (Mamy).
Lokacin bata ko gama secondary school ba, Allah ya d'ora masa masifar sonta, itama lokacin ta kamu da matsanaiciyar k'auanrsa.
Bilkisu Bilal su hud'une wajan iyayansu Adamu shine babba Bilkisu na binsa sai Abdurrahman, and Fauziyya, itace qarama kowanensu ayanzu yanada aurensa da yaransa Fauziyya ce d'a d'aya, da Mamy sbd basunsa  Khairy ba yarta bace .
Masha Allah sunada kyau zuri'arsu mahaifiyarsu Ce bafulatana, mahaifinsu bahaushene,fararene tass masha Allah, sunada rufin asirinsu daidai gwargwado.
Soyayya mai tsafta Shattima da Mamy sukayi, har ta idar da secondary school akayi maganar aurensu, akan bayan biki zataci gaba da jami'a agidanta.
Auren Mamy da Shattima aurene na soyayya da qaunar juna sukayi, suna bala'in son junansu kamar zaci juna kowa yana gudun b'acin ran d'an uwansa.
 Wata biyu sukayi suna gurzar amarci kafin ta masa mgnar komawa makaranta, bai musaba sabida yana son mace mai ilimi bare ita da zatayi karatu akan likitanci ta taimaki al'ummah.
Tin bata rufe shekara ba Auntie Aisha ta saka mata idanu akan wai ya shiru ba labarin ciki, Bilkisu bata damuba karatunta take anutse tinda mijinta yana sonta.
Lokacin da ta shiga zango na biyune akaratunta Aisha ta tisata gaba da maganganu har wasu daga cikin dangi na kama mata, har Aisha ta matsawa Shattima sai ya qara aure suka hau sama suka hau k'asa yace bazai qaraba ita ba uwarsa inno bace, haka haihuwa ta Allah ce, ba auren bane zai basu haihuwar.
Shattima ganin Mamy ta tashi hankalinta tana neman haihuwa idanu rufe, sunata zuwa gwaji asibiti ana fad'a musu lafiyarsu lau lokacine baiyi ba.
Shattima da kansa yaba Mamy shawara ta fara laulayin qarya alamar ciki gareta, da yaje wata uku sai suce ya zube haka haka har Allah yasa su sami cikin gasken, dan baya son ya mata kishiya haka baya son a tsaneta adanginsa.
Ai kuwa haka sukayi ta fara laulayin k'arya har tsawon wata uku kafin ace tayi b'ari, aikuwa Auntie Aisha ta sarara mata sai murna harda tattalinta take, ita dai burinta taga d'an Shattima, Allah yajarabeta da son k'anin nata.

_K'arfe uku na dare_
Shattima zaune yake tsakiyar qatuwar bedroom d'insa, saman wata tattausar darduma sanye da jallabiya sabuwa dal milk colour, sai wani irin bala'in qamshi yake, acikin awannin da suka wuce tashin hankalin da ya gabata har fuskarshi ta d'an yi rama duk da bazaka tab'a gane b'acin ransa ko zallar damuwarsa ko tashin hankalinsa ta fuskarsa ba, amma kallo d'aya zaka masa kasan baida wata nutsuwa.
Hannayensa sama addu'a yake yana kukan zuciya akan wannan lamari sabida Sam baiji ya amshi Khairy matsayin mata ba, abun akwai mugun nauyi babba.

Mamy da take can d'akinta itama sallar tayi sabida tsarkin da ta samu kusan 12 na dare, shiyasa tayi sallah tana roqon Allahn, ta gama taji tana buqatar kwanciya jikin mijinta ko ba komai taji sanyi a ranta.
    Hijab d'in ta cire ta cire rigan sallan ta mayar da rigan baccinta ta shafa humram mai shegen dad'i ta sanya hula akanta, ta fice zuwa sashen Shattiman.
Bata tsaya knocking d'in k'ofa ba dan tasan yanzu baya falon ta bud'e ta shiga ta murza key daga ciki, ta nufi bedroom d'in.
Ya miqe ya nufi bed kenan yaji qaran tab'a qofa.
Tsaye yayi fuskarsa ba walwala ya kafawa qofar bedroom idanu, bai fi second 10 ba ta murd'a k'ofar ta shigo bakinta da sallama.
Idanunsu suka manne waje d'aya tai k'asa da kanta sabida bala'in kwarjinin da ya mata.
Juyawa yay ba tare da ya cire jallabiyan ba ya haye tamfatsetsan royal bed d'insa, yana shigewa cikin wani tattausan pink d'in bargo mai fitar da azababban k'amshinsa, ya lumshe idanunsa.

Key Mamy ta murzawa qofar bedroom d'in.
Ta nufo gadon kanta qasa.
Kyawawan k'wayayen wutar d'akin ta kashe, ta kunna ta gefen gadon, tana qoqarin hawa bed d'in taji sautin daddad'ar amon muryasa mai sakamata qara sonsa anitse yana fad'in.
“Karki hau je d'akinki ina buqatar keb'ewa ni d'aya...”
Wani irin dam dam k'irjin Mamy ya buga, taji wani bala'in tashin hankali.
Kuka taji yazo mata sabida zafin abinda yace matan, gadon ta haye kai tsaye ta janye bargon ta fad'a k'irjinsa tana qanqameshi cikin kuka tace.
“Wlh bazan iyaba kamin hukunci ko wane iri amman banda hukuncin hanani rab'arka Wai Shattima kasheni kakeso kayi? da wannan zanji dan Allah meye laifina cikin wannan lamarin alkahiri fa na had'a...”
A hassale ya kamo kafad'unta cikin d'acin zuciya yana girgizawa yace...
